cautions.en: No public pricing grid; cost depends on activated modules, employee headcount, and any hardware (clocking terminals, badges).

capabilities.en: Time and attendance tracking with clocking terminals and remote-work supervision.
Staff scheduling, leave and absence management.
HR portal with electronic signatures, expense forms, and internal communications.
Physical access control: building access, visitor management, room booking, video surveillance.

limitations.en: No public pricing; requires a custom quote before purchase.
Full value requires proprietary hardware (badges, clocking terminals, access readers).

unknowns: No pricing figures published anywhere on the official site; third-party sources confirm quote-only pricing but give no indicative range.
Specific integration partners (payroll, ERP) are referenced generically as 'interoperable via API' without named partners.
